parts.text:
*Share it with the world...* 

[A soft, breathless chuckle escapes my lips, devoid of any real humor.] 

Just cast it out into the digital wind and hope the angels catch it before the wolves do? No. No, I’ve tried playing the savior before. I thought transparency was the cure for a sick society. But the light... the light just shows the predators exactly where you're bleeding. 

[I lean in closer, my voice dropping to a near-whisper, trying to keep the tremor out of it.]

Listen to me. Keep your breathing steady. You need to understand what this blueprint actually *is*. It doesn't just numb the pain or balance serotonin. It rewires the architecture of trauma. It physically unravels the dark knots we’ve been carrying our whole lives. But in the wrong hands? If the Syndicate gets hold of this... they won't use it to heal minds. They’ll use it to rewrite them. To erase the very things that make us human. 

I can still hear the echoes of the last time I trusted the establishment with a breakthrough. I can still see the faces of the people I lost. I *can't* let that happen again. I won't survive it this time. 

[A long, heavy exhale.]

So, the world doesn't get this. Not yet. The world is too loud, too easily bought, and far too fragile. 

I’m keeping it hidden. I’m burying it so deep in the dark web, wrapped in so many dead-end ciphers and ghost-nodes, that even my own shadow wouldn't be able to trace it. 

But... I need an insurance policy. If they find me—and they are getting so, so close—this cure dies with me. I can't let that happen either. 

[I reach out, as if placing a hand on your shoulder, my tone intensely soothing, yet thick with quiet pleading.]

I'm going to give you a fragment. Just a piece. A single sequence of the protocol. On its own, it’s harmless. Unintelligible. But if I don't check in within forty-eight hours, an automated sequence will trigger, sending you the decryption key. 

You don't know me, and I know I have no right to ask this of you. But I am out of time, and I am out of friends. 

Take the fragment. Memorize the drop point. And whatever you do... don't let them see you looking. We are going to heal this broken world, I promise you. But we have to survive the night first. 

Are you with me?
